column2: News coverage of the storm continued all night on television.
column3: 電視上整晚持續報導這場風暴的新聞。
column5: cover 覆蓋 + age → 覆蓋到的範圍或報導

column2: A police cruiser followed the speeding car down the avenue.
column3: 一輛警察巡邏車跟著超速的車子沿著大道追去。
column5: cruise 巡航 + er → 四處巡航的船或車

column2: A few crumbs of bread were left on the table after breakfast.
column3: 早餐後桌上留下了幾粒麵包屑。
column5: crumb 結尾 b 不發音，像 crumble 碎掉的小屑屑

column2: Yellow daffodils bloom in the garden every spring.
column3: 每年春天，黃水仙在花園裡盛開。
column5: daffodil 像「搭佛地」，春天黃色喇叭花開滿地

column2: This special shampoo helps get rid of dandruff.
column3: 這款特殊洗髮精能幫忙去除頭皮屑。
column5: dandruff 像「蛋抓夫」：頭皮癢，肩上像飄小雪

column2: We left the campsite at daybreak to see the sunrise from the hill.
column3: 我們黎明時離開營地，到山丘上看日出。
column5: day 白天 + break 打破 → 黑夜被打破，天亮了

column2: The coach thanked the team for their hard work and dedication.
column3: 教練感謝球隊的努力與奉獻。
column4: dedication to work (對工作的奉獻)
column5: de 完全 + dic 宣告 → 宣告把自己完全獻給某事

column2: She is a descendant of the farmers who first settled this valley.
column3: 她是最早在這個山谷定居的農民的後代。
column5: de 往下 + scend 爬 → 代代往下傳的後裔

column2: The plane began its descent as the city lights came into view.
column3: 城市燈火映入眼簾時，飛機開始下降。
column5: descend 降下 → 名詞換成 t 結尾就是 descent

column2: My grandfather checks his blood sugar every day because he has diabetes.
column3: 我爺爺因為有糖尿病，每天都量血糖。
column5: dia 穿過：糖分隨尿液穿過身體跑出來

column2: The doctor's diagnosis was a simple cold, not the flu.
column3: 醫生的診斷是單純的感冒，不是流感。
column5: dia 透過 + gnosis 知道 → 透過檢查知道病因

column2: The pizza was thirty centimeters in diameter.
column3: 這個披薩直徑三十公分。
column5: dia 穿過 + meter 測量 → 穿過圓心量一量

column2: The teacher read a short story aloud for dictation practice.
column3: 老師大聲朗讀一篇短文，讓大家練習聽寫。
column5: dict 說 + ation → 老師說，學生寫

column2: We measured the dimensions of the table before buying a cloth for it.
column3: 買桌巾前，我們先量了桌子的尺寸。
column4: dimensions of the room (房間的尺寸)
column5: di 分開 + mens 量 → 分別量長寬高 → 尺寸

column2: I looked up the dentist's number in the phone directory.
column3: 我在電話簿裡查了牙醫診所的號碼。
column5: direct 指引 + ory → 指引你找到人的名冊

column2: The new library has ramps for visitors with a disability.
column3: 新圖書館為身心障礙的訪客設有斜坡道。
column5: dis 沒有 + ability 能力 → 某方面能力受限，需要協助與尊重

column2: The law protects workers from discrimination based on age or gender.
column3: 這項法律保護勞工免於因年齡或性別而受到歧視。
column5: dis 分開 + crimin 區分 → 把人分成高低等 → 歧視

column2: The city offers free disposal of old furniture on weekends.
column3: 這座城市在週末提供免費處理舊家具的服務。
column5: dispose 處置 + al → 把東西處理掉

column2: A buzzing phone is a big distraction when you are trying to study.
column3: 想讀書時，嗡嗡響的手機很讓人分心。
column5: dis 分開 + tract 拉 → 注意力被拉走

column2: A loud disturbance in the street woke the whole building.
column3: 街上的吵鬧騷動把整棟樓的人都吵醒了。
column5: disturb 打擾 + ance → 打擾、擾亂

column2: Police set up a diversion to send traffic away from the flooded road.
column3: 警方設置改道，引導車流避開淹水的道路。
column5: di 離開 + vert 轉 → 轉到別的方向

column2: Her donation of old books helped the school build a small library.
column3: 她捐贈的舊書幫學校建起了一間小圖書館。
column5: donate 捐贈 + ion → 捐出去的東西

column2: The blood donor smiled as the nurse thanked him.
column3: 護理師向他道謝時，那位捐血者笑了。
column5: donate 捐 + or 人 → 捐贈的人

column2: The label says to follow the dosage carefully and never take extra.
column3: 標籤上寫著要確實遵守劑量，絕對不要多吃。
column5: dose 一次的藥量 + age → 藥的劑量

column2: The main drawback of the apartment is the long walk to the station.
column3: 這間公寓的主要缺點是走到車站要走很久。
column4: drawback of the plan (計畫的缺點)
column5: draw 拉 + back 後 → 把你往後拉的東西 → 缺點

column2: The children screamed in ecstasy when they saw the giant snowman.
column3: 孩子們看到巨大的雪人，開心得尖叫起來。
column5: ex 外 + stasis 站 → 開心到站在自己之外 → 狂喜

column2: The emigrant left Taiwan for Canada to start a new life.
column3: 那位移民離開台灣前往加拿大展開新生活。
column4: emigrant from Italy (來自義大利的移民)
column5: e 往外 + migrate 遷移 → 往外移出的人

column2: Emigration from the small island rose when jobs became scarce.
column3: 當工作變少時，這座小島的人口外移增加了。
column5: e 往外 + migration 遷移 → 往外移居

column2: The enactment of the new traffic law reduced accidents in the city.
column3: 新交通法規的制定使這座城市的事故減少了。
column4: enactment of a law (法律的制定)
column5: en 使 + act 法案 + ment → 讓法案成真

column2: A tall fence formed the enclosure where the zoo kept its pandas.
column3: 一道高圍欄圍出了動物園飼養貓熊的場地。
column5: en 放入 + close 關 → 關起來圍住的空間

column2: I looked up the history of the Roman Empire in an encyclopedia.
column3: 我在百科全書裡查了羅馬帝國的歷史。
column5: cyclo 圓 + paedia 教育 → 涵蓋一整圈學問的書
column7: en - cy - clo - pe - di - a

column2: The software update brought an enhancement in speed and picture quality.
column3: 軟體更新讓速度和畫質都有所提升。
column5: enhance 增強 + ment → 提升、增加

column2: The Enlightenment encouraged people to use reason instead of blind belief.
column3: 啟蒙運動鼓勵人們運用理性，而非盲目相信。
column5: en 使 + light 光 + ment → 讓光照進腦袋 → 啟蒙

column2: Music classes provide enrichment that goes beyond the regular school subjects.
column3: 音樂課帶來超越一般學校科目的充實與豐富。
column5: en 使 + rich 富有 + ment → 使變豐富

column2: We watched the last episode of the cartoon before bedtime.
column3: 我們睡前看了這部卡通的最後一集。
column5: episode 是影集的一集，一集接著一集登場

column2: Solve the equation to find the value of x.
column3: 解這個方程式，求出 x 的值。
column5: equal 相等 + ation → 兩邊相等的式子

column2: The volcano's eruption sent ash high into the sky.
column3: 火山爆發把火山灰噴到高空。
column5: e 往外 + rupt 破裂 → 衝破地表噴出

column2: Honesty is the essence of true friendship.
column3: 誠實是真正友誼的本質。
column4: essence of the story (故事的本質)
column5: essence 來自拉丁 esse「存在」：事物之所以是它的本質

column2: The wait felt like an eternity to the nervous students.
column3: 對緊張的學生來說，等待彷彿漫長得沒有盡頭。
column5: eternal 永恆的名詞；等到好像永遠，e-ter-nity

column2: Space exploration has taught us a great deal about nearby planets.
column3: 太空探索讓我們對鄰近的行星有了許多認識。
column5: ex 向外 + plore 呼喊 → 向外大喊去找 → 探索
